content.text: ▪︎HTN assoc w MI, HF, CVA, & CKD
▪︎RFs: age, obesity, high-Na diet, physical inactivity
(glomerulonephritis, polycystic kidney dz, SLE, tumors, atrophic kidney)
: drugs (OCPs, NSAIDs, cocaine, stimulants, venlafaxine), pheochromocytoma, Cushing’s syndrome, CoA, hyperparathyroidism
▪︎fundoscopic exam: ± hemorrhage, papilledema, cotton wool spots, arteriolar
: » sus when: severe/resistant HTN, onset <30yo, diastol HTN onset >65yo
: ⇡ SCr ≥50% after starting ACEI/ARB, unilat sm kidney, recurr flash pulm edema
▪︎Primary aldosteronism: hypokalemia w urinary K wasting, adrenal mass
▪︎Sleep apnea: overweight/obese, loud snoring, daytime sleepiness
▪︎Pheochromocytoma: paroxysmal ⇡ BP; triad of HA, palpitations, & sweating
▪︎CoA: UE SBP > LE SBP, ⇣/delayed femoral pulses
BP ≥130/80 avg from 2+ readings obtained on 2+ occasions
▪︎normal <120/80; elevated SBP 120-129 + DBP <80; stage 1 130-139 OR 80-89; stage 2 ≥140 OR ≥90
▪︎SBP + DBP in different categories → higher reading determines stage
▪︎isolated systolic HTN = SBP ≥130 w/ DBP <80; isolated diastolic HTN = SBP <130 w/ DBP ≥80
▪︎dx requires standardized measurement technique + repeated BP measurements in + out of office
▪︎24-hr ABPM = better predictor of target-organ damage + CV events than in-office measurements; use to eval white coat HTN when in-office ⇡ but out-of-office <130/80
▪︎white coat HTN = consistently ⇡ in-office w/ out-of-office not meeting dx criteria; masked HTN = consistently ⇡ out-of-office w/ in-office <130/80
: CBC, CMP, lytes (Na, K, Ca), fasting glucose, lipid profile, TSH, UA, EKG
: wt loss, DASH diet, smoke cessation, Na restriction ≤2300mg/d (≤1500 ideal), K intake 3.5-5g/d, aerobic exercise 90-150min/wk
▪︎wt loss → ⇣BP ~1 mm Hg per lb; obese pt: 20 lb wt loss > other lifestyle interventions
▪︎DASH diet: ⇣BP 6/4 mm Hg vs typical American diet at same caloric intake
▪︎aerobic exercise w/o wt loss: ⇣SBP ~4-6 + DBP ~3 mm Hg (moderate intensity 40 min 3-4x/wk)
▪︎⍉⇡dietary K+ to ⇣BP if impaired kidney K+ excretion (CKD, esp stages 3-5)
Threshold for initiation of pharmacological Tx:
AND clinical CVD, DM, CKD, or 10-yr CVD risk ≥7.5% (PREVENT-CVD)
*combo w fixed-dose single pill preferred in
▪︎⍉ACEi + ARB combo: dual RAAS blockade ⇡hyperK, hypotension, AKI; no added CV/kidney benefit over monotherapy
▪︎⇡ dose @ 1M intervals or add additional agent if BP remains ↑
